            <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: Crews work to restore power for thousands after Thanksgiving storm]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-crews-work-to-restore-power-for-thousands-after-thanksgiving-storm</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, crews are still working to restore power for hundreds of thousands of homes a day after a massive Thanksgiving storm forced some on the East Coast to dine in the dark, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy pushes back on President Trump, U.S. forces disabled ​a commercial ship in the Gulf of Oman and the U.N. says hunger is expected to worsen in 16 global countries and regions.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[American consumers face pitfalls with rise of 'buy now, pay later']]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/american-consumers-face-pitfalls-with-rise-of-buy-now-pay-later</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Black Friday is no longer limited to just a single day, yet it remains one of the busiest days of the year for brick-and-mortar stores, where shoppers can still stand in long lines. Now, 90 million of those consumers have turned to "buy now, pay later" financing programs. Economics correspondent Paul Solman looks at how this form of financing is becoming pervasive, and for many, a problem.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/how-online-gambling-is-changing-the-game-and-impacting-athletes</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Revenue from sports betting has now reached $17 billion. The enormous rise of legalized betting has some worried about where it's all heading, especially after a series of high-profile cases involving athletes betting on their own performance.             <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/exploring-an-ai-reboot-and-the-ethics-that-surround-it</link>
            <description><![CDATA[As artificial intelligence reshapes industries and our daily lives, questions about its use in drones, robots, and machines and the ethics behind how it's utilized have never been more urgent.
